_doc: Functions the omit/undef/null probes (gen_args.py) never call, only because the call has a host side effect that the sandbox (cwd-relative sb/ dir, loopback host/url) cannot contain. module/owner/name are regexes (full match; owner is the class or object path, empty for exports). Everything else is probed.

excludes.name: exit|reallyExit|abort|kill|_kill|chdir|setuid|setgid|seteuid|setegid|setgroups|initgroups|umask|dlopen|binding|_linkedBinding|execve|openStdin|setUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback|_debugProcess|_debugEnd|_startProfilerIdleNotifier|_stopProfilerIdleNotifier
excludes.reason: terminates, signals or re-identifies the harness process, or changes process-wide state
end/destroy/pause on the harness's own stdio would close the result stream

excludes.name: exit|reallyExit|abort|kill|_kill|chdir|setuid|setgid|seteuid|setegid|setgroups|initgroups|umask|dlopen|binding|_linkedBinding|execve|openStdin|setUncaughtExceptionCaptureCallback|_debugProcess|_debugEnd|_startProfilerIdleNotifier|_stopProfilerIdleNotifier
excludes.reason: terminates, signals or re-identifies the harness process, or changes process-wide state

excludes.name: group|groupCollapsed|groupEnd|time|timeEnd|timeLog|trace|profile|profileEnd|timeStamp
excludes.reason: indentation/timer state leaks into later probes, or the output carries a stack/timing

excludes.name: lookup|lookupService|resolve.*|reverse
excludes.reason: queries the system DNS resolver (external network)

excludes.name: open|waitForDebugger
excludes.reason: opens a debugger port / blocks until a client attaches

excludes.name: register|registerHooks|enableCompileCache
excludes.reason: installs process-wide loader hooks / writes a cache dir

excludes.name: watch|watchFile|createReadStream|createWriteStream
excludes.reason: long-lived handles; error is emitted asynchronously as an uncaught event, which the harness cannot attribute to a probe
